title: TODAY: Spirit Palm with a sword in your hand (frames from the game)

frames.name: still 1
frames.note: Just after the press. The thing in your hand is still there and nothing else has moved.

frames.name: still 2
frames.note: The strike. It is thrown with the weapon hand, so the weapon swings across the bottom of the view and an arm shows at the top right.

frames.name: still 3
frames.note: A ring and a dome round the target. The weapon is back at the right.

frames.name: still 4
frames.note: Over.

title: PROPOSED (a drawing, not the game): the left hand casts and the sword stays

frames.name: tick 0
frames.note: The press. Your sword is still in your hand.

frames.name: tick 2
frames.note: The left hand draws back to the hip and light starts up the arm. The sword drops into a low guard.

frames.name: tick 4
frames.note: The palm drives out along the aim, the wrist turned flat.

frames.name: tick 5
frames.note: Contact. The light leaves the arm through the palm.

frames.name: tick 8
frames.note: The hand recoils a little and holds while the echo travels through the target.

frames.name: tick 13
frames.note: Home. The sword is already back up, and you can swing.

frames.name: still 1
frames.note: The gather. Only the tips of the fists show, at the very bottom edge.

frames.name: still 2
frames.note: The burst. The whole screen goes yellow and the target catches the game's own fire.

frames.name: still 3
frames.note: The fists are back near the corners.

frames.name: still 4
frames.note: The weapon pops back into view.

title: PROPOSED (a drawing, not the game): Nova

frames.name: tick 0
frames.note: The press.

frames.name: tick 3
frames.note: The forearms cross at the chest, laid right across your view. Light gathers where they meet.

frames.name: tick 6
frames.note: One beat held tight. The view pulls back a little and the world goes quiet.

frames.name: tick 7
frames.note: The right arm goes first.

frames.name: tick 8
frames.note: The left follows a tick later. Both swing past where they'll stop.

frames.name: tick 12
frames.note: They settle back, and the last of the light fades from the arms.

title: PROPOSED (a drawing, not the game): your arm shows the power you are casting

frames.name: Kinetic
frames.note: Cracks of ember light, like stone about to split.

frames.name: Velocity
frames.note: Red streaks that run toward the fist.

frames.name: Flight
frames.note: Pale motes lifting off the skin.

frames.name: Energy
frames.note: A white-blue vein that forks.

frames.name: Shadow
frames.note: Ink that creeps back from the hand.

frames.name: Mind
frames.note: Rings that close round the wrist.

frames.name: Architect
frames.note: A drawn gold grid.

frames.name: Tech
frames.note: Plates that lock on with dark seams.

frames.name: Spirit
frames.note: Tongues of jade flame from the hand.

title: PROPOSED (a drawing, not the game): Shockwave fits what your body is doing

frames.name: Standing
frames.note: The stomp, as today: the knee comes up into view and the boot goes down.

frames.name: In the air
frames.note: You come down fist first. The wave leaves from your knuckles as they hit the ground.

frames.name: At a sprint
frames.note: A slide kick. Your heel digs in and the wave runs out ahead of the slide.
